title: Atkinsonella texensis B6155 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: Atkinsonella texensis is a systemic parasite of the grass, Nassella leucotricha (Texas needlegrass), and reproduces in fruiting bodies (stromata) that choke immature host inflorescences, preventing seed production. This fungus is a close relative of mutualistic symbionts (endophytes) such as the Epichloe species.
samples: Pathogen: environmental/food/other sample from Salmonella enterica
